articles.title: PACERS at 76ERS | FULL GAME HIGHLIGHTS | November 15, 2026
articles.summary: The 76ers defeated the Pacers, 131-124 tonight in Philadelphia. Jaylen Brown contributed a team-high 31 points to go with 3 three pointers 2 rebounds and 2 assists, with Tyrese Maxey of the 76ers adding an additional 27 points (9-19 FG, 5-10 3P) in the game.
body: Never miss a moment with the latest news, trending stories and highlights to bring you closer to your favorite players and teams.
points: The 76ers defeated the Pacers, 131-124 tonight in Philadelphia.
Jaylen Brown contributed a team-high 31 points to go with 3 three pointers 2 rebounds and 2 assists, with Tyrese Maxey of the 76ers adding an additional 27 points (9-19 FG, 5-10 3P) in the game.
Pascal Siakam finished with a team-high 31 points along with 2 rebounds for the Pacers in the losing effort.
The 76ers improve their record to 11-3 with the win, while the Pacers fall to 5-9 for the season.
